answer: In PoA, each challenge commits to a future drand quicknet pulse whose threshold-BLS signature is unpredictable until its round, then derives task parameters by domain-separated hashing of the pulse, commitment, and agent identity. Thus plume, orchard, and raven swarms cannot precompute answers, stockpile offline work, or coordinate sybil identities; proofs are checked against the beacon and commit-reveal transcript, making influence require costly, timely participation rather than identities.
